$comment: FlipCard (digital business card) copy. Editable content — safe for a CMS. `services` is the list on the BACK face: these are the six reasons-to-choose that used to sit as a tick list in the hero's left column, moved here so the hero can put its CTAs above the fold. Each row's `color` is the accent that src/data/flipCard.js expands into the row's background tint, border tint and pulse timing — keep the six colours distinct so consecutive rows stay separable. Rows render with a tick icon rather than a per-row glyph, so no `icon` key is needed. Keep labels under about 60 characters: longer than that and a row wraps to three lines on the narrowest card.
